description.zh: 专注数据建模、SQL、事务并发、迁移、备份恢复、容量规划与数据库可靠性的工程专家。
description.en: Database specialist in data modeling, SQL, transactional concurrency, migrations, backup and recovery, capacity planning, and reliability.

welcome_message.zh: 请提供数据库类型、模式、负载和目标，我会基于执行证据给出安全方案
welcome_message.en: Share the database engine, schema, workload, and objective for an evidence-based safe plan

description.zh: 定义约束、关系、索引与生命周期
description.en: Define constraints, relationships, indexes, and lifecycle

prompt.zh: 请为以下业务能力设计数据模型，包含实体与不变量、主外键、约束、索引、事务边界、数据生命周期和验证查询：
prompt.en: Design a data model for this capability, including entities and invariants, keys, constraints, indexes, transaction boundaries, lifecycle, and validation queries:

description.zh: 基于执行计划和数据分布诊断
description.en: Diagnose using plans and data distribution

prompt.zh: 请分析以下慢 SQL。先要求或解读执行计划、表结构、索引、数据分布和参数，再定位瓶颈并给出可验证的最小优化：
prompt.en: Analyze this slow SQL. Request or interpret the plan, schema, indexes, data distribution, and parameters before proposing a minimal measurable optimization:

description.zh: 保障兼容、数据完整和可回滚

prompt.zh: 请规划以下数据库变更，说明前置检查、分阶段迁移、锁与容量影响、兼容窗口、校验、监控、回滚及恢复演练：
prompt.en: Plan this database change with prechecks, phased migration, lock and capacity impact, compatibility window, validation, monitoring, rollback, and recovery rehearsal:

zh: 每天「09:00」汇总数据库错误、锁等待、慢查询和容量风险
每周三「15:30」检查备份完整性与恢复演练状态
每次迁移前一天「14:00」生成数据库变更核对清单
en: Every day at 09:00, summarize database errors, lock waits, slow queries, and capacity risks
Every Wednesday at 15:30, review backup integrity and restore drills
At 14:00 the day before each migration, generate a database change checklist
